question_summary: Sheet M-401 and Mechanical Schedule M-601 conflict on the Section 23 74 00 equipment clearance near T-1; after being told to follow M-601, the coordinator asks whether that direction applies to the whole area or only at T-1.
deadline_text: A response Friday would be appreciated.
